body:
it's finally cardigan weather where i am, so i typed exactly that into Mood expecting it to hand me folklore. (cardigan! it's RIGHT there!)

instead the first song it pulled was Never Grow Up. Speak Now. 🥹 then seven, then Tim McGraw, then New Year's Day, then We Were Happy — five songs about holding onto something soft before it slips away.

that's the thing i love about this feature: it didn't match the obvious word, it matched the feeling under it. cardigan weather isn't really about a sweater, it's about wanting time to slow down. Mood heard that.

tag the person you'd spend the whole cozy season with — then go tell Mood your own weather on longlivets.com 💛

critique.rationale: cardigan weather should scream folklore, so Mood leading with Never Grow Up from Speak Now is a genuine, specific surprise that teaches what the feature does. Warm, lowercase, real named results and a real tag-hook; the tour photo is the one weak spot since Mood has no era deep-link.
